scripts.coverage: npm run build && node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && node --test --enable-source-maps --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=packages/npm/** --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=coverage/js.lcov tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.coverage:python: coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py && coverage xml
scripts.coverage:go: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage', { recursive: true })" && go -C packages/go test -count=1 -covermode=atomic -coverprofile=../../coverage/go.out ./...
